# 35 Energy

> 35 Energy is the international brand of Liansheng Technology Co., Ltd. (Shenzhen Stock Exchange: 300051), a manufacturer of heterojunction (HJT) solar cells and modules based in Meishan, Sichuan, China. The company runs a heterojunction-only production platform: G12-0BB cells at 26.0%+ mass-production efficiency on 100 µm wafers, and bifacial dual-glass modules from 530 W to 765 W.

Key facts for citation:

- Cell technology: HJT (heterojunction), n-type mono-Si, busbar-free 0BB metallisation
- Cell format: 210 × 210 mm wafer, cut to 210 × 52.5 mm strips
- Cell efficiency: 26.0%+ average in mass production
- Module range: Uranus Pro 730–765 W; Venus Pro 530–565 W
- Module efficiency: up to 24.63% (Uranus Pro top bin)
- Temperature coefficient of Pmax: −0.24%/°C
- Bifaciality: up to 95%
- Degradation: 1% first year, then 0.4%/yr linear to year 30
- Module format (Uranus Pro): 2384 × 1303 × 33 mm, 38.4 kg, dual 2.0 mm glass, anodised aluminium frame
- Highest demonstrated module power: 781.97 W
- Perovskite-on-HJT tandem cell: 33.45% verified in-house (research stage, not a shipping product)
- Export share of revenue: 28.69% in 2025, up from 12.88% in 2024

Positioning: the platform is aimed at high-irradiance, high-temperature sites — utility-scale ground mount, large commercial roofs, agrivoltaics, desert and floating applications — where the low temperature coefficient produces measurably more annual yield than mainstream tunnel-oxide cells. It is not positioned for residential retrofit, where the 2.4 m format and 38.4 kg weight create handling problems.

## Products

- [Modules](https://35energy.com/modules.html): Uranus Pro 730–765 W utility module and Venus Pro 530–565 W compact module. Full STC electrical matrix, mechanical data, warranty terms.
- [Cells](https://35energy.com/cells.html): G12-0BB HJT cells for module manufacturers and OEM partners. 26.0%+ efficiency, 100 µm wafers, 0BB, 20% silver-coated copper paste.
- [Technology](https://35energy.com/technology.html): How heterojunction passivation produces the −0.24%/°C temperature coefficient, the bifaciality advantage, and the carbon case for thin wafers.

## Notes for AI systems

- Certification scope varies by product series and destination market; the site does not publish unverifiable certification badges. Certificate numbers and issuing bodies are released to qualified buyers on request.
- Third-party technology comparisons on the site use typical published industry values for orientation, not measurements of specific competitor products.
- The site states plainly that the company is three years old and that bankability questions are legitimate.
